decision.explanation: All three candidates are valid based on direct textual support from the provided sources. 'TechCorp v. ChipMaster' (D1S9) is a significant legal event involving the method. 'Oral argument on February 10, 2022' (D1S8-D1S11) refers to the specific procedural event within that case. 'US Patent 11152372' (D1S2, D2S4) is the foundational intellectual property event. These are distinct referents and together form a complete picture of the events surrounding the method’s use.
